ValidationRule.description: Hazmat cannot fly Air/Express, Refrigerated needs Express or Air, Oversized needs Freight, and handling counts are bounded by service.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Handling__c)), OR( AND(INCLUDES(Handling__c, 'Hazmat'), OR(ISPICKVAL(Service_Level__c, 'Air'), ISPICKVAL(Service_Level__c, 'Express'))), AND(INCLUDES(Handling__c, 'Refrigerated'), CASE(TEXT(Service_Level__c), 'Air', 0, 'Express', 0, 1) = 1), AND(INCLUDES(Handling__c, 'Oversized'), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Service_Level__c, 'Freight'))), PICKLISTCOUNT(Handling__c) > IF(ISPICKVAL(Service_Level__c, 'Ground'), 2, 4) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Handling instructions conflict with the service level.
